title: E2E.Adversarial.NZB.Tar.Size.Lie.2026-TESTGRP
description: A ustar archive holding one 2 MiB member, posted in 256 KiB articles whose every =ybegin states size=536870912000, the most the yEnc layout trusts. The archive's end blocks arrive where its bytes end, so the member comes out byte-equal and nothing is allocated for the stated length alone.
